item.title: Luka Is Having One of the Greatest Scoring Seasons EVER 🔥
item.description:
Luka Dončić is averaging 36.6 points per game through 16 games of 2026-27, the 7th-highest single-season mark in NBA history, behind five Wilt Chamberlain seasons and Michael Jordan's 37.1 (1986-87). Can he keep it up all season? 👇
Stats: Basketball-Reference, through Nov 24, 2026.
